# Rick's Rebrewed Cafe

> Independent local cafe in Grimsby town centre serving breakfasts, brunch, burgers, jackets, weekly specials and drinks. Banter breakfasts, buffets and banging food on West St Mary's Gate.

Rick's Rebrewed Cafe is an independent cafe at 9 West St Mary's Gate, Grimsby, DN31 1LB. Open Monday–Saturday 8:30am–2:30pm (breakfast till 1:00pm). Closed Sundays. Order in-store or on Just Eat. Phone: 07359 421858. Email: Ricksrebrewed@gmail.com.
